message.content: {"caption":"A two-stage workflow for constructing a memory bank and using it to generate answers.","description":"The diagram has two horizontal, rounded stage panels. In the upper blue panel, “Stage 1: Memory Construction,” an icon of two people conversing is labeled “Dialogues.” Solid right-pointing arrows connect Dialogues → “Info Extraction” → “Search Memory Bank” → “Memory Manager” → “Memory bank constructed.” Inside the Memory Manager are four vertically stacked operations: ADD, UPDATE, DELETE, and NOOP. In the lower green panel, “Stage 2: Memory-Guided Answer Generation,” a question-and-chat icon is labeled “Questions.” Solid right-pointing arrows connect Questions → “Retrieve Memory” → “Memory Augmented Prompt” → “Answer Agent” → “Answer.” The Answer Agent contains a box labeled “Generation with Memory Distillation.” Gray dashed connectors link the memory-bank area with the lower retrieval and prompt process: a dashed path runs leftward across the gap and has a downward arrow into Memory Augmented Prompt; another dashed branch reaches the area above Retrieve Memory, with no clearly visible arrowhead there. At the right, a dashed vertical connector has an upward-pointing arrow into Memory bank constructed. The dashed connectors have no labels.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
